newsitem.title: USA: Vornado to buy Mendik Co for $654 million.
newsitem.headline: Vornado to buy Mendik Co for $654 million.

text.p: Vornado Realty Trust said Wednesday it agreed to buy Mendik Co for $654 million in cash and debt to expand its size in the Manhattan office market.
As part of the transaction, Vornado, a real estate investment trust, will convert to an umbrella partnership, the company said.
Mendik owns and manages four million square feet of Manhattan office space in seven midtown buildings. Bernard Mendik, principle of Mendik Co, will become co-chairman of Vornado, the companies said.
Vornado will pay $269 million in cash and $168 million in privately placed Vornado UPREIT limited partnership units and assume $217 million of debt, the company said.
